title: No cloud test checks that a number shown in several places is the same everywhere
what: Counts an owner or member sees in more than one place (alerts on the bell and in the list, dues, plan end, members using the app, the same gym's numbers in HQ) are each tested on their own, if at all. The cross-role journeys follow orders, cancels, messages and check-ins between the apps, but never compare one count across the panel, Today, the AI answer, a push, the phone app and HQ. No cloud run uses a messy test gym either (someone who joined today, a plan that starts later, no visit yet, a gap of weeks). Other parts of this audit found such counts already disagree in HQ, and nothing in the cloud would have caught it.
expected: One cloud check builds a small messy test gym and asserts that each shared number (alerts, dues, plans ending, birthdays today, members on the app) comes out the same in every place that shows it.
how_often: whenever two places count the same thing differently
fix_line: Add one cloud check on a messy test gym that compares each shared number across every place it shows
